tailoring.headline: Senior Backend Java Engineer | Java, Spring Boot & REST APIs | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and web ecosystems for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer
cover_en.hook: Assuresoften's focus on building advanced web and mobile platform ecosystems closely aligns with my technical background. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have designed and engineered robust enterprise platforms, RESTful APIs, and scalable backend services.

bullets.label: Backend & API Engineering
bullets.text: Developed and exposed robust OCC REST Web Services, headless APIs, and backend functionality using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot across enterprise web platforms.

bullets.label: Platform Ecosystems & Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered complex data pipelines, API integrations, and system connectivity across diverse enterprise systems and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, optimized FlexibleSearch and SQL queries, and improved transaction speed and system stability for high-volume platforms.

bullets.label: Reliability & Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, managed cloud deployments via CCv2 and Docker, and supported production environments within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and integration experience can contribute to Assuresoften.

tailoring.,why_company: Assuresoften stands out through its commitment to building advanced web and mobile platform ecosystems and scalable backend architectures. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise Java and platform development experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to help your engineering team design robust, high-performance solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise Java, Spring Boot, and robust backend engineering experience to build scalable platform ecosystems at Assuresoften.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a Senior Java Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise backend systems, REST APIs, and platform ecosystems at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed Assuresoften's opening for a Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer and would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer position at Assuresoften.

With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise backend systems, RESTful APIs, and scalable web platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and database performance optimization. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start from 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
